limits: All 96,000 fits passed the frozen guards. This verifies the planned Chapter6 simulation attempt, not all dissertation claims, universal optimizer correctness, or whole-dissertation success.

108 primary paired variance-SE contrasts are strictly positive after Bonferroni adjustment within that prespecified family. They support lower mean estimated variance-component SE for full information in this grid, not directly measured rejection power, efficiency under all populations, or exact constancy across conditions.

216/216 variance-SE source deviations exclude zero only conditionally on extracted source points and their geometric bounds. Source Monte Carlo uncertainty, seeds and exact implementation remain unknown. These are not full two-sample replication tests, equivalence tests or rounding failures.

Path SE = variance SE / (2 sqrt(estimated variance)) is an explicitly different estimand. Its 20/216 conditional deviations suggest a possible source labeling/procedure explanation but cannot prove it or replace the printed variance-SE targets.

MAR bias is estimate minus generating truth; residual h2 truth .5 uses A/(A+C+E), not A/1.64. Eleven opposite point signs have zero adjusted ours intervals excluding zero. They do not establish meaningful sign reversals of a source scientific conclusion, nor prove unbiasedness.

Primary low-missingness comparisons implement methods/captions 2%; plots and some prose say3%. The separate3% sensitivity family does not resolve that ambiguity or authorize favorable selection between them.

Bonferroni families are separate: primary paired108, sensitivity36, path108/36, source variance216, path216, MARsource72 and MARbias72. No familywise95% coverage claim across all these families jointly is justified.

Extraction bounds encode a geometric reading tolerance, not source sampling error, printed precision or a scientific equivalence margin. Analysis plan was recorded during production before new production effect summaries, after the known20-replicate baseline; do not call it fully prospectively preregistered.

Mapped parent/child references share rows and are not independent replications or a success-count denominator. Empirical-data, power and nonquantified claims remain unadjudicated by this simulation mapping.
